{{Short description|French physicist}}

'''Jean Salençon''' is a [[:Category:French physicists|French physicist]] born on November 13, 1940. He is a member of the [[French Academy of Sciences]] and the [[French Academy of Technologies]].

== Biography ==
An engineer with degrees from the [[École Polytechnique]] (X1959) and the [[École nationale des ponts et chaussées]] (1964), a [[Doctor of Science|doctor of science]] ([[Pierre and Marie Curie University|Université Pierre et Marie Curie]], 1969), Jean Salençon was a professor at the École nationale des ponts et chaussées from 1977 to 1998 and a professor at the École polytechnique from 1982 to 2005. He has also taught at several prestigious schools and universities in France and abroad. He was non-resident Rector of CISM (Udine) from 2004 to 2012 and a member of several university or industrial scientific councils in France and abroad and of the Board of Directors of the [[Conservatoire national des arts et métiers|Conservatoire national des Arts et Métiers]] (CNAM) from 2005 to 2011.<ref>{{cite web|title=Conservatoire National des Arts et Métiers|url=http://oer2go.org/mods/fr-wikipedia-static/content/a/conservatoire_national_des_arts_et_m%25c3%25a9tiers.html|date=}}{{Dead link|date=October 2024 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>

A member of the Academy of Sciences since 1988, he was its president in 2009 and 2010<ref name=":1">{{cite web|title=Académie des sciences|url=https://www.academie-sciences.fr/fr/Liste-des-membres-de-l-Academie-des-sciences-/-S/jean-salencon.html|date=}}</ref> and, as such, chaired the Institut de France in 2009. Jean Salençon is an honorary general engineer in the field of [[civil engineering]] and was a founding member of the Academy of Technology.<ref>{{cite web|title=Académie des technologies|url=https://www.academie-technologies.fr/members/205-jean-salen%C3%A7on|date=}}{{Dead link|date=March 2023 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>

== Scientific work ==
Jean Salençon's research work concerns the mechanics of continuous media,<ref>Salençon, J., Handbook of Continuum Mechanics, Berlin, Springer, 2001</ref><ref>Salençon, J., Mécanique des milieux continus, Paris, Éditions de l’École polytechnique, Palaiseau; Ellipses, tome i. + cd-rom, (2016). tome ii. + cd-rom, (2007). tome iii, (2016)</ref><ref>Salençon, J., Virtual Work Approach to Mechanical Modeling, ISTE – Wiley, Wiley online library, 2018</ref> the calculation of structures and civil engineering structures, and the irreversible behaviour of solid materials for industrial applications.

He was particularly interested in the irreversible behaviour of materials ([[Plasticity (physics)|plasticity]],<ref>Salençon, J., Théorie de la plasticité pour les applications à la mécanique des sols, Paris, Eyrolles, 1974</ref><ref>Salençon, J., Application of the Theory of Plasticity in Soil Mechanics, Chichester, John Wiley and Sons Ltd, 1977</ref><ref>Salençon, J., Plasticité pour la mécanique des sols. Limit Analysis and Rheological Approach in Soil Mechanics, W. Olszak et L. Suklje ed. Springer-Verlag, 1979, <abbr>p.</abbr> 95-166</ref><ref>Salençon, J., de l’Élasto-plasticité au Calcul à la rupture, Paris, Editions de l’École polytechnique, Palaiseau; Ellipses, 2002</ref> [[viscoelasticity]]<ref>Salençon, J., Viscoélasticité pour le calcul des structures, Paris, Éditions de l’École polytechnique, Palaiseau & Presses des Ponts et Chaussées, 2009</ref><ref>Salençon, J., Viscoelastic Modeling for Structural Analysis, STE – Wiley, Wiley online library, a paraître</ref> and their industrial applications. He is the author of the theory of computation at break<ref>Salençon J., Calcul à la rupture et analyse limite, Paris, Presses de l’École Nationale des Ponts et Chaussées, 1983</ref><ref name=":0">Salençon, J., Yield Design, London, UK; Hoboken, NJ, ISTE – Wiley, 2013</ref> which he implemented for the first global computation of the [[bearing capacity]] of surface foundations on homogeneous or heterogeneous [[Isotropy|isotropic]] soils<ref>Matar, M. et Salençon, J., Bearing capacity of strip footings. Foundation Engineering, Paris, vol. 1, G. Pilot ed. Presses de l’École Nationale des Ponts et Chaussées, 1983, <abbr>p.</abbr> 133-158</ref><ref>Matar, M. et Salençon, J., Bearing capacity of circular shallow foundations, Paris, Foundation Engineering, vol. 1, G. Pilot ed. Presses de l’École Nationale des Ponts et Chaussées, 1983, <abbr>p.</abbr> 159-168</ref> or [[Anisotropy|anisotropic]] soils<ref>Salençon, J. et Tristan-Lopez, A., « Analyse de la stabilité des talus en sols cohérents anisotropes », ''C.R.Acad.Sc.Paris. t. 290'', série Série B, 23 juin 1980, <abbr>p.</abbr> 493-496 (lire en ligne)</ref><ref>Salençon, J. et Tristan-Lopez, A., « Calcul à la rupture en mécanique des sols: cas des sols cohérents anisotropes », ''Annales de l'ITBTP'', série Sols et fondations, 182, mars-avril, 1983, <abbr>p.</abbr> 53-83 (lire en ligne)</ref> and also for stability analyses of earth and [[mechanically stabilized earth|reinforced soil]] structures.<ref>de Buhan, P. et Salençon, J., « A comprehensive stability analysis of soil nailed structures », ''European Journal of Mechanics'', a, 12, n°3, 1993, <abbr>p.</abbr> 325-345</ref> In the case of foundations or structures subjected to [[Seismic loading|seismic loads]], the method is used for "pseudo-static" analyses.<ref>Salençon, J. et Pecker, A., « Ultimate bearing capacity of shallow foundations under inclined and eccentric loads », ''European Journal of Mechanics'', a, 14, n°3, 1995, <abbr>p.</abbr> 349-396</ref><ref>Chatzigogos, C.T., Pecker, A. et Salençon, J., « Seismic Bearing Capacity of a Circular Footing on a Heterogeneous Soil », ''Soils and Foundations'', 47, 4, 2007, <abbr>p.</abbr> 783-797</ref> He also developed this theory in the probabilistic framework both from the point of view of material strength and stress and showed that it is the theoretical basis for ultimate limit state design (ULSD<ref>Carmasol, A. et Salençon, J., « Une approche probabiliste du dimensionnement des structures par le calcul à la rupture », ''Journal de Mécanique Théorique et Appliquée'', 4, n°3, 1985, <abbr>p.</abbr> 305-321</ref><ref name=":0" />), which is incorporated in some current design regulations.

== Honours and awards ==
He is a member of the Academy of Sciences, the Academy of Technology, the Istituto Lombardo, Milan (foreign member), the Academia das Ciéncias de Lisboa (foreign member), the [[Hungarian Academy of Sciences]] (honorary member), the [[Academia Europaea]],<ref>{{cite web|title=Academia europaea|url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Salen%C3%A7on_Jean|date=}}</ref> the [[Hong Kong]] [[Institute for Advanced Study]] (Senior Fellow),<ref>{{cite web|title=Hong-Kong Institute|url=https://www.ias.cityu.edu.hk/en/profile/jean-salencon|date=}}</ref> the Montpellier Academy of Sciences and Letters (correspondent).

He is Commandeur of the Ordre de la [[Légion d’Honneur|Légion d'Honneur]], Commandeur of the [[Ordre des Palmes académiques|Palmes Académqiues]] and Officier of the [[Ordre national du Mérite|Ordre du Mérite]].
